data.title: LUCENT POOLS - Project Photos & Reviews - Fort Worth, TX US

reviews.text:
I have always taken care of my pools pretty much by myself, but after fracturing my femur at the knee 3 months ago and having a friend mention the Groupon available for filter cleaning I decided I could use the help in that nasty chore. I am so glad I did; after having  bad experiences with the outfits I've used for remodel or installations I now feel I have a place to contact when I get into something over my head.
I was sure I would have to wait for the filter cleaning because of recent demands due to freezing temps, but I was added to the Flower Mound schedule at once and Brady showed up and completed the job efficiently and proceeded patiently and skillfully to check out other problems I had mentioned when scheduling. Long story short, I feel I have finally found my Go-To place for pool issues.
reviews.author: Paula Miller

reviews.text: I purchased a filter clean Groupon from Lucent Pools. They were very professional and got to me promptly. I called and set up my filter clean with Sarah who was extremely professional and polite. They came out the next day and allowed me to hang around while the filter was being cleaned. Did everything that I asked and even helped me with another issue I was having with my pump and didn't even charge me. I would highly recommend using Lucent Pools. Richard and Justin have been very helpful and very patient with my pool questions, lol. Two thumbs up!!!!!
reviews.author: Roy Florez

reviews.text: The gentleman that came to my home was very friendly and knowledgeable. He cleaned my filter and checked for any issues. He wasn't pushy about selling me replacement parts and gave me some tips as I take care of my pool myself usually.
reviews.author: Bryan Brant

reviews.text: The pool technician Mike arrived on time and quickly cleaned and serviced the DE filter.  He also checked pool chemistry. Mike also informed me that I may have been adding too much DE to my filter after backflushing. He instructed me as to the proper amount of DE to add following backflushing.
reviews.author: Bobby Vandenbush

reviews.text: I found Lucent Pools through Groupon; I needed a filter clean. The technician was extremely knowledgeable, professional and courteous. I will definitely be calling them again for the next service.
reviews.author: Amanda Viola

reviews.text: I've used Lucent Pools for two years and they are outstanding!  They are prompt, courteous and really know their way around pools and pool equipment.  I recommend them highly!
reviews.author: Jim Caldwell

reviews.text: I had a few issues initially with the company, but the owner called me and did a great job in making everything great.  He went above and beyond to make me happy with the service.  They do care about making their customers happy and satisfied.  I would use again.
reviews.author: Barb free

reviews.text: This swimming pool company is the best. They have worked with me on a lot of issues and have been very helpful and professional.
reviews.author: Beverly Wimer

data.summary: Reviews appear authentic but from a low-volume, possibly less active contractor. The content is highly specific and varied, indicating real customer experiences, though many are dated. The owner demonstrated good customer service in resolving a complaint. The main concern is the small number of recent reviews.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (10 Google, 8 Houzz)
Several reviews from 8-10 years ago, limited recent activity

positive_evidence: Owner called to resolve issues and went 'above and beyond'

authentic_signals: Specific details: Groupon purchases, filter cleaning, technician names (Mike, Richard, Justin), specific pool issues (DE filter, pump)
Mix of praise and one mention of resolved initial issues
Emotionally authentic language from real customers
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (5.0) and Yelp (4.1). BBB has no rating but no complaints. No major platform conflicts.
